transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
Um... I suppose I'm just exhausted. It's... well, sleep doesn't really fix it. Just getting through a normal workday and, you know, dinner at home... it just feels heavier than it should right now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
Yeah, I suppose... most days. It's just... I wake up with this heavy, sort of gray feeling. Like... I don't know, like I'm already disappointed in the day before it even starts.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or that activities feel like a chore even if you used to look forward to them?
I guess... yeah. I usually paint, or... go to museum exhibits. But lately, I don't know. My supplies are just sitting there untouched. I just... can't really make myself care enough to go.
Have you been feeling fatigued or like you don’t have energy most days, even when you haven’t done much physically?

Yeah... like I mentioned earlier, I guess. I'm just exhausted. It doesn't really matter if I haven't done anything strenuous... just getting through work and then dinner at home, it just feels heavier than it should. Sleeping doesn't really fix it.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, or do you still have some interest but just don’t feel like doing them?
I don't know... like I was saying about the painting. I just don't care right now. It's not really that I want to do it and just... can't. The interest just isn't there.
Have you noticed a change in your ability to get things done or stay motivated, even for simple tasks?

Yeah... I suppose so. Like at work, sometimes I'll just sit there with a simple staffing email open and... I just reread it over and over. I can't really decide what to say, or... which option makes sense. It's just... yeah.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating a lot more or a lot less than usual?

I suppose... a little less. I just sort of pick at my meals lately. Or I'll... I'll just forget to eat lunch at work. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything, but... I guess my work skirts are fitting a little looser.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has this been going on for weeks, months, or longer?

Um... about a month, I guess. I was actually... really driven right before this, getting a lot done. But then it just... swung the other way. So, yeah... it's been about four weeks of just feeling... low.
Have you been feeling like you're not good enough or felt excessive guilt about things lately?

Um... I guess you could say that. I just... I keep replaying things in my head lately. Like missed family plans, or... tense conversations with my husband. It's... I don't know. I just feel like I'm letting everyone down right now. As a wife... a mother... and a manager.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or that life isn’t worth living lately?
Um... no. No, I haven't had any thoughts like that.
Would you say that you’re completely unable to feel any pleasure or joy in anything these days, even things you used to really enjoy?

Um... I suppose so. I usually... well, I normally like to paint. Or wander through museum exhibits. But lately... my supplies are just sitting there untouched. I just... I can't really make myself care enough to go or do any of it right now.
Have you been waking up earlier than usual and not being able to go back to sleep, even when you still feel tired?

Um... yeah, I suppose. Even when I get to bed at a reasonable hour now... I just wake up around four or five. My mind just starts in on work, or... my marriage. And then... I'm just done sleeping. I can't really get back to sleep after that.
Have you noticed that you're moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the contrary, feeling restless or fidgety without being able to settle down?

Um... maybe a little slower. At work, my staff has actually pointed out that I'm... slower to answer questions in meetings lately. Like there's just... a pause, before I can get my thoughts and words moving.
Would you say that you’re completely unable to feel any pleasure or joy in anything these days, even things you used to really enjoy?

Um... I think I just mentioned this a minute ago. With the painting and the museums? I just... I leave my supplies sitting there. I can't really make myself care enough to do any of it right now. I don't really know what else to add.
Would you say that you’re completely unable to feel any pleasure or joy in anything these days, even things you used to really enjoy?
I... I thought we just went over this. Like I said, the painting... the museums... I'm just not doing them. There's really no joy in it right now. I don't know what else to tell you.
Would you say that you’re completely unable to feel any pleasure or joy in anything these days, even things you used to really enjoy?

I... I really don't know why we keep coming back to this. 

Yes. Like I just said... I usually love painting, and going to museums, but my supplies are just sitting there untouched. I just can't make myself care enough to do it or go anywhere. That's... that's really all there is to say about it.
Have you noticed that your thoughts or movements have become noticeably slower, to the point where others might have observed it?

Um... I suppose so. At work, my staff... they've actually mentioned that I'm slower to answer questions in our meetings lately. It just feels like... like there's a pause before I can really get my thoughts and words moving. But that's all.
